gaps.sentence: The hotel was full, so we couldn't check ___.
gaps.explanation: check in = register; check out = leave and pay.

gaps.sentence: These old boots are completely worn ___.
gaps.explanation: wear out = become thin/unusable through use.

gaps.sentence: She put her ideas ___ clearly and confidently.
gaps.explanation: put across = communicate an idea successfully.

gaps.sentence: They put ___ the meeting until everyone could attend.
The caterpillar will turn ___ a butterfly.
Sales figures have tailed ___ since the summer.
She looks ___ on people who disagree with her.
gaps.explanation: look down on = consider inferior (opposite: look up to).
